s: Din hayyashen bassukka ubo z' seipim: tzarik lesheb tachat avir hassekak shello yehe ohel acher mapsiq beno lehassekak, kede sheyyihyeh yosheb betzel sukka velo betzel ohel, veeno niqra ohel ella dabar shehu gaboah asara tepachim min haaretz, veap al pi sheen lo depanot asur lesheb tachtayv, lepikak hayyashen tachat hammitta bassukka im hi geboha[h] asara tepachim — lo yatza yede chobato:

Veken hayyashen tachat hakkilla happerusa sebibot hammitta beshippua, im yesh lah gag tepach, dehaynu sherochab tepach mimmennu parus beyosher al gabbe hammitta velo beshippua, kegon shehakkelonas shehu taluy bo uperusa al gabbayv yesh bo rochab tepach, veyesh asara tepachim min gag tepach zeh ad haaretz, ap al pi shemmimmennu ad hammitta sheyyashen aleha en sham asara tepachim — ap al pi ken lo yatza yede chobato, shekkol gag tepach haggaboah asara tepachim min haaretz — niqra ohel, venimtza sheeno yashen betzel sukka ella betzel ohel:

Vaapillu en lah gag tepach, im yesh bepachot mishshelosha tepachim samuk laggag rochab tepach, dehaynu leachar sheyyorda meal hakkelonas mikkan umikkan venitrachabu tepach, en sham min tepach zeh ad hakkelonas shelosha tepachim beyosher — asur lishon tachtayv apillu shello keneged tepach zeh (ayyen sop siman trl"a), lepi shekkol pachot mishshelosha tepachim hu kelabud ukeillu yesh begaggah rochab tepach, vekol dabar sheyyesh lo gag rachab tepach — kullo niqra ohel, venimtza ohel mapsiq beno lehassekak:

Mi shepperes sadin al gabbe qinop, dehaynu arbaa quneddasin habboletin mearbaat ragle hammitta umanniach kelonesot mizzeh lazeh upores alehen sadin — asur lishon tachtayv middibre soperim, apillu im rashe quneddasin ellu enan gebohin asara tepachim min haaretz, kevan sheyyesh lahem gag rachab tepach beyosher, dehaynu hassadin shepparus al gabbayv milmala:

Abal im quneddas echad bolet beemtza hammitta meraashoteha vehashsheni bolet kenegdo bemargeloteha umanniach kelonas mizzeh lazeh upores alayv sadin, kevan shehassadin parus beshippua veen lo gag rachab tepach beyosher — muttar lishon tachtayv, vehu sheen hakkelonas gaboah asara tepachim min hammitta, abal im hu gaboah asara tepachim min hammitta*umah shebbakkilla modedin haasara tepachim min haaretz vekan modedin otan min hammitta, haynu lepi shehakkelonas shehakkilla perusa al gabbah enennu qabua bammitta veim tinnatel hammitta lo tinnatel hakkilla, abal kan hakkelonas qabua bequneddasin habboletin min hammitta veim tinnatel hammitta yinnatel hassadin, vetaam lechilluq zeh yitbaer besop siman tr"l, ayyen sham hattaam. — Asur lishon tachat hassadin:

Muttar lipros bassukka qeramim hamtzuyyarim usedinin hamtzuyyarim kede lenaotah, ben sebib hakketalim, ben tachat hassekak, veap al pi shehen meqabbelin tuma upesulin lesikkuk kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trk"t — ap al pi ken en poselin et hassukka bearbaa tepachim kedin sekak pasul, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"b. Velo od ella shemmuttar apillu lesheb tachtehen mammash, ap al pi shehen gebohin asara tepachim min haaretz — enan chashubin ohel lehapsiq beno lehassekak, lepi shehen betelim legabbe hassekak, kevan shennaasu letzorek hassekak dehaynu lenaoto, veod shekkol shello naasa letzel en shem sekak alehem, ulekak en poselin et hassukka mishshum sekak pasul, umuttar lesheb tachtehen, lepi shehen betelin legabbe hassekak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen semukin betok arbaa tepachim lehassekak, veaz hen betelin etzlo, abal im hem muplagin mimmennu arbaa tepachim — enan betelin etzlo, uposelin et hassukka kedin sekak pasul, veal derek sheyyitbaer besiman trl"b. Umikkol maqom, ap al pi shessekak pasul eno posel et hassukka ella im ken yesh bo arbaa tepachim abal im en bo arbaa tepachim muttar apillu lesheb tachtayv, ap al pi ken yesh lizzaher shello leharchiq noye hassukka min hassekak arbaa tepachim ap al pi sheen bahen arbaa tepachim, gezera shemma yihyeh bahen arbaa tepachim, sheaz asur lesheb tachtehen:
Vekol zeh benoye hassukka, abal im peres tachat hassekak dabar sheeno noy lassukka — yitbaer besiman trk"t, ayyen sham:
